digest.component_or_area: test infrastructure, pytest configuration, ruff lint rules
propositions: Adopt ruff codes PLW1510 (subprocess without check), PT001, PT006, PT007, PT008, PT012, PT013, PT017, PT021, PT022, PT028 (pytest style) in [tool.ruff.lint] select, clearing 481 findings tree-wide under src, tests, scripts.
Add timeout=20, timeout_method='thread', timeout_func_only=True to [tool.pytest.ini_options] so local pytest runs have a per-test 20 second budget with explicit override for slow integration tests.
Mark integration-tier tests exceeding 20 second budget with @pytest.mark.timeout(N, func_only=True) and a one-line comment explaining the override.

Lower CI budget flags in .github/workflows/_build-and-test.yml lines 658 and 673 from --timeout=300 to --timeout=20, keeping --timeout-method=thread, and add drift assertion in test_ci_workflow_parity.py verifying equality with ini timeout.
Add hygiene script invocations (check_wall_clock_asserts.py, check_raw_git_writes.py) to make lint recipe for local reachability, matching precedent of check_comment_hygiene.py.
